canada.title: Victims identified in fatal shooting outside Surrey Walmart
canada.summary: Homicide investigators have identified the two victims of a fatal shooting in Surrey, B.C., on Nov. 15 outside a Walmart near 88 Avenue and 124 Street.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge shooter used ChatGPT to build 3D gun parts, U.S. magazine reports
canada.summary: Mother Jones reports that ChatGPT helped killer Jesse Van Rootselaar make a 3D-printed gun magazine and foregrip, and gave advice on how to fix a spring, before the deadly mass shooting on Feb. 10.

canada.title: Gamers in Ottawa, Gatineau sink hours into GTA VI after hotly anticipated release
canada.summary: Ottawa video game streamer Triston Cooper will be focused on one thing over the next few days: playing Grand Theft Auto VI in his dorm at Carleton University.

canada.title: Historic guns locked away as RCMP centre set to become next national museum
canada.summary: At the RCMP Heritage Centre in Regina, which is set to become Canada's next national museum, one display case is glaringly empty.

canada.title: Ontario Liberals to select third new leader since 2018
canada.summary: Ontario's Liberal Party will wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader.

canada.title: London man arrested hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list
canada.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say they have arrested a man in a homicide investigation, only hours after he was placed at No. 14 on Canada's most wanted list of fugitives.

canada.title: Nova Scotians ask questions about digital sovereignty, diesel generators, wind farms at public sessions on EverWind’s AI data centre
canada.summary: Nova Scotia government hosted two more virtual public engagement sessions on Wednesday and Thursday.

canada.title: Better ministerial reporting could grow Albertans' confidence in how tax dollars are spent: auditor general
canada.summary: Alberta’s auditor general says he believes provincial ministries could make improvements to how they report on their achievements, and that doing so could increase public trust in how the government is performing.

canada.title: Canmore glamping project decision postponed, public barred from speaking
canada.summary: A decision on a contentious glamping project near Canmore’s Quarry Lake will wait following a two-hour planning commission meeting where members of the public were not allowed to speak, prompting further criticism.

canada.title: Threatening message about City of Weyburn pool project sparks calls to improve discourse
canada.summary: The now-deleted comment, which made reference to shooting city officials, is part of "a broader pattern of hostile and personally directed comments toward members of City Council and municipal employees across the country," the city said in a statement.

canada.title: Generator repairs and overhaul in Rankin Inlet, Nunavut, will mean easier winter, says Qulliq Energy
canada.summary: Last winter, the community experienced six power outages in as many weeks when two of Qulliq Energy Corporation's four main generators were out of service.

canada.title: Northern Manitoba fire chiefs look for new equipment, more volunteers following wildfires
canada.summary: After devastating forest fire seasons in 2024 and 2025, two northern Manitoba fire departments adapting to changing needs are looking for help — one with new equipment, one with finding more volunteer firefighters.

canada.title: They finally had their dream food truck. Then it was repossessed
canada.summary: A family ran their business, LeoMay Fusion, out of a food truck for about a year in rural Nova Scotia until RCMP officers showed up in mid-October and they learned a previous lender was repossessing the vehicle.

canada.title: N.B. patients face 3½-hour ER waits, down an hour from previous year, report finds
canada.summary: New Brunswick emergency room patients typically waited about 3½ hours to be either admitted to hospital or discharged in 2025-26, down an hour from the previous year, according to a new report by a public policy think-tank.

canada.title: ‘We’re at a loss’: private clinics frustrated by provincial cap on cataract surgeries
canada.summary: In 2025, New Brunswick started funding cataract surgeries in private clinics to address a significant patient backlog. But with more than four months left in the fiscal year, some clinics are already close to hitting their quotas.

canada.title: Parents say this N.S. driving school ‘ghosted’ them after they paid hundreds of dollars
canada.summary: Several parents with children enrolled in Marshall Law Driving Academy say they feel blindsided by its sudden closure last week after each paying the company hundreds of dollars.

canada.title: Pilot program that welcomes doctors in training to Yukon on path to permanency
canada.summary: Health Minister Brad Cathers says the Yukon government and University of Alberta aim to bring more family medicine residents into the territory on an ongoing basis. The pilot program has so far brought in three residents, including two Yukoners.

canada.title: Metrobus still working on staffing shortages as it gears up for recruitment push this weekend
canada.summary: Metrobus will be holding an open house on Saturday, Nov. 21 for anyone who may be interested in a position as a driver or mechanic, or in otherwise contributing to maintaining and expanding public transit.
